currentweather.title: Weather Matrix
currentweather.description: Parses hyper-local coordinate arrays, cross-referencing live precipitation probabilities and 24-hour rainfall trends against canopy drainage models to calculate soil stability.

primeridetime.title: Prime Ride Time
primeridetime.formula: Solar Arc × Wind Velocity × Radar Gaps = Joy Score
primeridetime.description: Maps multi-model weather inputs to a normalized performance scalar. Tracks oncoming fronts, crosswinds, and daylight limits to generate a safe departure window.

routeconditions.title: Trail Status Indicator
routeconditions.description: Calculates real-time substrate track conditions by correlating live moisture saturation percentages against fixed mechanical trail ruggedness classes.

routemetrics.title: Route Analytics
routemetrics.formula: Track Vectors ──► Conic Dial Fills ──► Signal Maps
routemetrics.description: Evaluates track variables by running linear interpolation calculations over your raw telemetry mileage, steepness curves, and regional cellular network availability grids.

efforttax.title: Effort Tax Gauge
efforttax.formula: Total Vert + (Friction Coeff × Grade Modifier) = Cost
efforttax.description: Calculates an accurate 'Feels Like' distance modifier by weighting vertical gain, steep pitch resistance, and tire rolling resistance against tarmac defaults.
bullets: ✓ Calibrates pacing models to unpaved trails

riskradar.title: Risk Radar Map
riskradar.formula: 5-Axis Surface Tension Matrix [I, E, E, S, V]
riskradar.description: Processes cellular coverage drops, terrain fall-line safety, maximum grade stress, surface slickness, and remote trail difficulty vectors simultaneously.
bullets: ✓ Visualizes trail personality at a glance

placestosee.title: Places to See
placestosee.formula: Midpoint Coords ──► Network Routing ──► 5 POIs Max
placestosee.description: Calculates true path travel distances to landmarks. Uses actual mountain bike network topology instead of inaccurate straight-line estimates.

emergencyservices.title: Emergency Services
emergencyservices.tagline: Google Places API LEO & Fire-EMS Anchor
emergencyservices.formula: WGS84 Origin ──► Radius Text Search ──► First Responder
emergencyservices.description: Locates the nearest active dispatch center or EMS facility relative to the route coordinate origin, pulling verified emergency numbers and route-miles.

elevationprofile.title: Elevation Profile
elevationprofile.description: Resamples the route into 1200 equidistant points, running them through a Savitzky-Golay filter window to clean out GPS elevation noise and track real slopes.
bullets: ✓ Maps physical pacing across the route
